title: Greening manufacturing: technology intensity and carbon dioxide emissions in developing countries
summary: The paper asks whether medium- and high-technology manufacturing industries are less emissions-intensive than low-technology ones in developing countries. It finds that medium- and high-technology industries are associated with lower CO₂ emissions, with differences that vary by countries' income levels.
keyFindings: Medium- and high-technology manufacturing is associated with lower CO₂ emissions than low-technology manufacturing.
The differences vary with countries' income levels.
A shift towards more technology-intensive manufacturing could be one part of environmentally sustainable industrialisation.
methods: Panel of 68 developing and emerging economies, 1990–2016, using two emissions measures and generalised method of moments (GMM) estimation.
